prompt: How do you mine your mind for the spark and impetus of desire again when all seems the same and nothing ignites the will to do anymore
response: When inspiration seems to be lacking, it can be helpful to take a break from your routine and engage in activities that you find enjoyable or stimulating. Sometimes, stepping away for a while can allow your mind to recharge and return to your work with renewed energy. You can also try setting smaller, more achievable goals to build momentum and regain your drive.
